'''Arkon Lok''', also known as '''Arkon "Nine Fingers" Lok''' due to his lack of one of his fingers, was a member of the military forces of [[House Rist]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He led Rist forces in establishing a satellite relay atop [[Mount Tessef]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces.
